candidates.headline: 15% off core items
candidates.rationale: New shoppers often buy core items; offering 15% off SKU-A02 and SKU-F01 boosts cross‑sell potential.

candidates.headline: Rs 200 off Comfort Bundle
candidates.rationale: Bundling comfort items with a Rs 200 discount encourages new buyers to add complementary products.

candidates.headline: Free SKU‑F02 with any SKU‑A02 purchase
candidates.rationale: Free SKU‑F02 with any SKU‑A02 purchase nudges new customers to try related accessories.

candidates.headline: Earn 100 loyalty points on first purchase
candidates.rationale: Granting 100 loyalty points on first purchase builds long‑term engagement for new shoppers.

candidates.headline: Check out our top sellers
candidates.rationale: A gentle reminder of top sellers keeps new customers engaged without cost.

candidates.headline: 20% off SKU‑F01 for new shoppers
candidates.rationale: A maximum 20% off on SKU‑F01 offers the strongest price incentive within limits to convert new shoppers.
